modules.name: AdGuard Home
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Shows which sites each device looks up and what was blocked, alerts about malware sites, mining pools and random-looking domains, and lets you block or allow sites per device or for everyone. Works with AdGuard Home and its Home Assistant add-on.

modules.name: Certificates and domains
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Warns before the TLS certificates on your web services (NAS, router, home server, websites) and your domain names expire. Works with self-signed certificates in the home network too. Domain dates come straight from the registry (RDAP or WHOIS), no account needed.

modules.name: Home Assistant (MQTT)
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Sends security alerts (with a fixed type per alert for automations, plus the device, IP, MAC and details such as the port or program), the number of unknown devices, and the devices you pick (presence, IP, MAC, top sites and an Internet pause switch) to Home Assistant through your MQTT broker. Home Assistant finds everything by itself (MQTT discovery).

modules.name: Home Assistant
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Alerts when Home Assistant stops answering, shows its version and pending updates, and makes sure its computer can never be paused (it often runs your DNS filter or smart home).

modules.name: Jellyfin
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Alerts when your Jellyfin media server stops answering, and shows who is streaming right now (useful when the network feels slow).

modules.name: NETGEAR router log
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Reads the log from a NETGEAR router or access point that cannot send syslog (tested with R6850). Alerts when it restarts. NETGEAR only lets one admin in at a time, so it never logs out someone who is already logged in.

modules.name: Prometheus metrics
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Lets monitoring systems read NetMaster's measurements in the standard Prometheus format: response times, packet loss, services, uptime checks, speed tests and which devices are online. Works with Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, Elastic, Checkmk and others.

modules.name: SIEM / syslog
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Sends NetMaster's alerts (new devices, attacks, open ports, outages ...) to your log server or SIEM as syslog, CEF or JSON: Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Wazuh, Graylog, Elastic, QRadar, ArcSight, rsyslog and others.

modules.name: TP-Link router
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Reads the system log, connected clients and live traffic from a TP-Link router (Archer and Deco models supported by tplinkrouterc6u). Adds a security check of the router's settings and lets you pause a device's internet. Never logs you out: if you are logged in to the router's web page, it waits.

modules.name: UPS (NUT)
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Alerts when the power goes out and your UPS runs on battery, when the battery is low or needs replacing, and when the power is back. Reads a NUT server: a Synology or QNAP NAS, a Raspberry Pi, pfSense/OPNsense or Home Assistant's NUT add-on with the UPS connected by USB.

modules.name: Webhook
modules.author: NetMaster
modules.description: Sends NetMaster's alerts to another system as they happen: ticket and on-call systems (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Jira), automation (n8n, Power Automate, Zapier, Home Assistant) or chat (Microsoft Teams, Slack, Discord).
